title: EconomicAuthoritySessionPurchaseResponse
description: POST /sessions 200 response body. See hosted/a2a_economic_authority/sessions.py::handle_session_request. `service_fee` and `authority_ceiling_usd` are always separate fields -- the fee is what was paid to Inferrail, the ceiling is buyer-declared policy metadata Inferrail never holds.

session_id.description: Server-generated (secrets.token_hex(16)). NOT knowable by the buyer before this response arrives -- this is exactly why /sessions/recover is keyed on payment_nonce instead. See recovery.schema.json.

authority_ceiling_usd.description: Canonical decimal string of the buyer-declared ceiling. Never a deposit; Inferrail holds none of it.

amount_usd.description: The actual x402 fee charged, e.g. "0.05". Configurable via ECONOMIC_AUTHORITY_SESSION_PRICE_USD; always a separate figure from authority_ceiling_usd.

status.description: Always "PAID" on a 200 response -- under this route's x402 "upfront" payment flow, settlement has already succeeded before this handler ever runs, so there is no code path that reaches a 200 with a lesser status.

root_capability.description: The root capability token, shown exactly once. `null` when this exact payment_nonce was already claimed by an earlier call (ordinary duplicate delivery) -- see `note` below.

token.description: Opaque bearer token. Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every A2A SendMessage call and on POST /capabilities/claim. Never persisted anywhere in plaintext by Inferrail -- only its SHA-256 hash.

scopes.description: The root token always carries all six scopes.

newly_claimed.description: true only on the transaction that actually minted `root_capability`. false on a retry of the same payment_nonce (root_capability is then null).

note.description: Present only when root_capability is null.
